items.subject: Spatial and temporal cache-blocking controls
items.objective: In `src/candidate.cpp`, compare spatial blocking within one timestep against halo-correct fusion of multiple consecutive timesteps per tile. Account for the radius-3 expanding halo, the recurrence's dependence on both time levels, even/odd buffer parity, and untouched boundaries. Keep explicit SIMD and thread parallelization out of scope; include scratch allocation in timing. Preserve full output initialization and numerical tolerance, validate smaller checks and n=256, and record correct results even if a variant is slower, since it may inform a later combination.
